caption: One of the easiest remedies against migraines #wellness #healthybodyhealthymind #wellnessjourney #chinesemedicineworks #usahealth
transcript: This is for migraines. My mother used this remedy every time the pain became unbearable. Take a small amount of VapoRub and place it at the base of the neck, where the head meets the spine. Lay a warm, wet cloth over it. Hold for 10 minutes. The migraine begins to release before the cloth even cooled. Comment yes if this helped you. And for more relief like this, my book, Time to Heal, holds practical routines for specific complaints, rooted in traditional Chinese medicine. Find it in my profile, my friend.
